title: Payment Gateway: Refunds, Webhooks, and Idempotency
description: Design refund flows, webhook retries, and idempotent payment APIs.

data.text: Extend the payment gateway with partial and full refunds, webhook delivery with retries, and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges.

data.title: Refund and Webhook Delivery
Webhook reliability
data.text: Webhooks fail. Always retry with exponential backoff, move to a dead-letter queue after 5 failures, and expose a webhook retry endpoint for merchants.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Refund is a first-class entity linked to Payment
Partial refunds track remaining refundable amount
Webhooks need idempotency keys and retry logic
data.takeaway: Payment gateways are never just about charging cards. Refunds, webhooks, and idempotency are what make them reliable at scale.
